chat.title: Chat
chat.guestBanner: Log in to chat with other players

chat.infoGlobal: Visible to all players around the world, regardless of country.
chat.infoCountry: Only players from your country see these messages. Your country is detected automatically from your device.

city.title: City
city.tagline: A City is all about community!
city.description: Players in a city communicate and help each other.
city.bonusDescription: All city members receive free bonuses that boost revenue and experience!
city.requirementDescription: Cities accept players who have built 10 or more floors.
city.joinDescription: Submit a request and you'll be invited by the city's mayor.
city.rankingsDescription: Or find a city in the rankings and leave a request on the city forum.
city.createDescription: Create your own city and become its Mayor!

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: Track your progress across all achievement categories. Each level you complete earns gems and a permanent income or XP bonus.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Invite friends to play. You earn rewards when they register, reach level 10, or level 30, and a bonus whenever referred players make in-game purchases.

myBusiness.title: My Business
myBusiness.description: View your unlocked floor types and upgrade their revenue bonus by spending tokens. Each upgrade adds +5% to earnings for that business category.

dailyTasks.title: Daily Tasks
dailyTasks.description: Complete 9 daily challenges — buy, list, collect goods, lift visitors, and more — to earn coins, building materials, and tokens. Resets every day at midnight.
